prs.tagLine: Secure long term tenancies in  high quality homes
prs.location:
The scheme will be located near the town centre where there is easy access to shops, medical facilities, recreational facilities,  various school (both National and Secondary) and childcare facilities along with  3rd level education (Maynooth university). Maynooth Business campus along with Carton Retail Park provide employment opportunities locally. 

The scheme is on the edge of Maynooth town adjacent to the M4 motorway which bypasses the town connecting the town with Dublin and the west - Athlone, Galway & Sligo. Maynooth is also on the Dublin-Sligo railway line and is served by InterCity train services (connecting Maynooth to Dublin city and suburbs) The train station is located approx. 850 meters from the estate. The town is also serviced by Bus Eireann which connects the town with various towns / cities throughout the country.
prs.aboutDevelopment: Clúid Housing is proud to offer not-for-profit cost rental housing to the public. This new rental option is supported by the Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage. Cost rental is not-for-profit housing. Your rent covers the cost of the construction, management, and maintenance of your new home. Cost rental offers you a long-term, secure tenancy that is more affordable. We've managed to achieve rents that start at 25% below the average local area rent. Cost rental is a long-term rental option.

description:
These 6 new cost rental homes located at in The Grange, Celbridge Road, Maynooth, Co. Kildare  - are one bed apartments.

All homes are A rated and highly energy efficient. The properties are semifurnished, giving tenants the flexibility to personalise their homes to their own taste.

Each home includes white goods, including a fridge freezer, a dishwasher, an oven and hob, a microwave and washer/dryer as standard. Additional features include roller blinds throughout—with blackout blinds in all bedrooms—as well as flooring and  tiled bathrooms.

Please note that parking is very limited within the development and will not be available for most residents. 

If you are interested in one of these properties and would like to find out more information and how to apply, please visit our website https://www.cluid.ie/COST-RENTAL
features: Semi-Furnished Property (white goods, flooring and window blinds are included)
